Results.ReviewText: After years of harassment from my daughter, I finally gave in and picked up an Ironwood 650 during a Black Friday Sale. I chose to take a boxed one so it would be easier to transport home. Assembly was a breeze, though I would caution folks to make sure they remove the protective cover from the temperature probe. The directions made no mention of this step and I only discovered the error during the seasoning process when the  indicated temperature continued to climb well past what I had it set at. Fortunately I caught it in time and removed the melted plastic before any damage occured and continued the seasoning process. That evening I attempted my first product, a grilled Delmonico Steak. As warned by a friend, grilling steaks is not this grill's strong point. Undeterred, I tried again the next day with smoked burgers. They took much longer than my gas grill and what the recipe stated, but the results were exceptional. The smoked wings I made for supper that evening were a success as well. What I have learned is that this grill is really a smoker. It does a great job for that purpose. Can you prepare a steak with it? Of course you can, but it isn't a replacement for a gas grill in my opinion, but instead a compliment to one. I will keep my gas grill for quick meals during the week and use my Traeger for smoking on the weekend.

Results.ReviewText:
I've owned my Ironwood 650 for about 4 months now, it is without a doubt the best grill I've ever owned. We use it for just about any application where you would want to use a grill or standard kitchen oven. I especially love this thing for ribs, brisket, and beef jerky. For anyone considering this grill I've got a few recommendations:

-WiFi: The grill only supports a 2.4ghz connection, if your router doesn't support that you will be very disappointed. Also don't assume that your signal is strong enough to get to the grill, I did have to get an extender.

-Trager App: Sometimes it misbehaves, just force stop it and reopen and you'll be fine. Beyond that it's one of the best product apps I've ever seen in terms of content and features.

-Get the optional front shelf, it's sturdy enough to handle just about anything that will fit on the grilling surface and adds much appreciated real estate to work with.

-Buy your pellets at Home Depot, and buy 4 bags at a time. They discount bulk purchases by about 25%, I have been able to mix and match pellet types (Signature, Hickory, & Mesquite) and still receive the discount. For US Military Veterans and those that live in states with no sales tax, the deal is that much sweeter.

Enjoy!

Results.ReviewText:
The Ironwood 885 is an impressive unit, quickly delivered in style, and is a welcomed upgrade from the Junior Elite!  The setup was simple, with everything labeled to humorous step-by-step instructions. But, once physically set up, I had trouble connecting the WiFire 30' away from my router.  WiFire is a great start and a nice advancement in grilling, but needs a little improving.  The room inside the grill is perfect for my needs - parties of 10 people are no problem and even preferred! Operationally it has been a breeze however, there are a couple items that should be addressed.

At first, the level of smoke seemed non-existent, but after the updates it seemed to improve. I am still questioning how much smoke is truly being generated and wanting more, but the level of temperature control with convection is perfect - it stays within several degrees of desired internal temp.  Back to the smoke, and more specifically the Super Smoke setting; it doesn't seem to make any difference, and visibly, I don't see any more smoke coming out of the unit with it on or off. You can't tell me the meat soaks it all up and it just burns more efficiently (which is what I have been reading on the forums).  To easily address this, I would like to see an update come out with all egos set aside.

All-in-all, we are enjoying the Ironwood 885 nearly every day of the week and our food is coming out perfectly cooked (steady convection and temp control), but for the price and being a newer generation with all the fancy features I am hopeful for updates - which is why I took the leap and purchased the Ironwood 885 with WiFire.  

Happy Smoking!

Results.ReviewText:
I’ve been a huge Traeger fan since I bought a pro 34 maybe 8 years ago.  It was still going strong, but we were moving across country, and I had a neighbor who admired my older grill, and I left it for him.  So when we got to our new home, we immediately did our research and decided on the Ironwood 885.

We expected something similar to our older and beloved Traeger, but we got much more. The mechanics are so interestingly cool.  Where the old one fed pellets at a constant rate, the new one seems to rush pellets to the fire when needed, and slow down when not.  It gets to temperature faster and reacts to changes more quickly.  

I thought that the WiFire was a gimmick, but it surprisingly the coolest thing about the Ironwood.  I find myself watching the grill from my office as it smokes my briskets. The extra smoke mode is SO GOOD. 

It was easy to put together, is made of sturdy stuff, and I expect it will be as long-lived as my older one.  It’s not a cheaply made grill.  (My old one survived many winters, a snowmageddon or two where it was buried for several weeks, and terrible east coast humidity with no rusting, no real signs of aging.)

The food is fantastic. Skip gas grills. Skip coal. Traeger is the way to go.

A thing about Traegers.  When I got my first one, I was so enamored with it, the food was so differently delicious, that I made it my corporate gift of choice. When I had a team had a member who really had a good year, I got them a Traeger as a thank you.  It may be the greatest corporate gift ever, and everyone was psyched to get one. I’ve bought maybe 10 in the last few years.

Anyway, Traegering and the Ironwood is a really good choice.  It will last a long, long time, and the food is something special.  My daughters love bacon on the Traeger (it *is* weirdly fantastic), and my son and I love Traegered steaks and brisket. The recipes on the website are really great.

VERY happy with Traeger and my newest grill.

Results.Title: Very nice.

Results.ReviewText: I got this grill for Father's Day. I have BBQ'd a lot, never smoked anything. I went through all the set up and seasoning instructions. First grill it would not hold temperature at 225. Dropped to 195. Had to increase temp to 350 to get grill up to 225, then drop temp to get it keep it around 225, then it would drop again. This went on the whole time I was cooking. Second time I used the grill I smoked a pork shoulder. Started at 11 pm. I decided to start high at 250 and back down to 225 over the first hour hoping this would fix the aforementioned issue. Grill held temp at 250 perfectly, held temp at 245 perfectly, held temp at 240 perfectly, held temp at 235 perfectly, held temp at 230 perfectly, did not hold 225. As soon as I set it to 225 it dropped again to 195. This happened both with the super smoke feature on and with it off. However, the super smoke feature only works at 225 or below. I ran the grill all night at 230. Woke up at 6 am. Set the grill to 225 with super smoke on and it held perfectly for the rest of the cook. It's worked great since. I have only two more complaints. First, the app tells you the level of wood pellets you have left, i.e. 70%. However, the auger sits on the left side of the hopper, so as the wood feeds into the auger, it feeds from the left side and the level of the pellets drops on the left side of the hopper faster than the right side. I went to sleep at 100% level, woke up six hours later at 25% and about started crying. Why is it using so many pellets?! Go out to grill and level out the wood pellets by hand, app immediately registers 70% pellet level. If I had been away from the house, hypothetically, and saw the level at 25% after six hours, I would've returned to the house to add more when in reality it wasn't necessary. Not a big deal but something to know. I don't know if the sensor is using weight and the imbalance inside the hopper is causing this error or if the sensor goes off the level of the wood pellets inside the hopper. Second, maybe the app has this feature, maybe it doesn't, but I would love to be able to look at a graph of both the ambient temperature inside the grill and the meat thermometer over the life of the cook. See how fast meat is coming up to temp, where the stalls are, etc. Currently, it's either not available or I can't figure out how to get to that feature. I know other meat thermometers have this feature but it would be nice to have this all contained in one app. Other than those complaints, the grill has worked great. Excellent cook once it held 225 and the meat turned out fantastic. Five stars if pellet level indicator issue is fixed and app tells you temp progression through life of the cook.
Results.Title: My First Traeger

Results.ReviewText: The Ironwood series is top of the line! It is extremely easy to use and great quality. The flavor is undeniably the best! I cooked with gas grills for many years and pellets are the superior alternative by far. There is no comparison! Traeger all the way!

I bought this last (Ironwood 885) because we are eating at home more as a result of the pandemic and I want to try more recipes.

I love the WIFIRE capability.  It means that I don’t have to set alarms to go check temperatures.  Now my grill switches to stay warm on its own based on probe temperature.

I had to learn as I went/spent.  Now that I have made the learning journey, I wish I had 
started with this grill instead of buying the pro series 34 7 months ago)in the interiM.

This wifire is the way to go!
Results.Title: I’m on my third Traeger

Results.ReviewText: Amazing grill, I don’t know why I waited so long to make this purchase. 100% worth the investment, probably 2 times over.
Results.Title: What are you waiting for

Results.ReviewText: We use our new grill almost every single day!  We have made everything from ribs, chicken to meatloaf and pizza.  It is so easy to use and absolutely everything we have made has been amazing!

Results.ReviewText: Ordering process was very easy. Grill arrived fast, have used it several times and love how well it works. Only issue I order seven bags of pellets that have not arrived yet and no word when they will arrive

Results.ReviewText: Traeger has gone DIGITAL! And it is amazing. I highly suggest using the Traeger app for not only thermometer readings and internal temperature of the grill, but there are awesome tips, tutorials, trainings, recipes, rubs/spices, and a bunch of other amazing things on there! We smoked a brisket for the first time using a Traeger recipe and rub and it turned out sooooo delicious! We are so pleased with how efficient this version of the grill is!
Results.Title: WIFI EFFICIENT

Results.ReviewText: It didn’t come properly assembled from the factory.  The wire that connects to the hot rod was lying in the electric area bound together with a zip tie.  After hours of attempting to fish the wire through the small hole, I got it to work.  Because of the lack of working space in the electrical area I bruised myself pretty good.  Had several challenges with Customer Care, even did a video to show them the issue.  Once I completed the assembly that Traeger should have done, the grill works great.
Results.Title: Traeger Ironwood 650 Issue - Direct from Traeger

Results.ReviewText: I had the pro 34 first time I ever cooked to temp instead of time I can’t tell you how much I liked that.  But this grill takes it to another level being able to control from anywhere is awesome just wish I had the duel probs.

Results.ReviewText: This is my first pellet grill and I must say the food that comes out from it is super delicious. The ease of use is amazing, set it and forget it really works. The app lets me concentrate on other things while my Ironwood 650 does the work, especially on long cooks its a game changer for me. Another thing I like is the recipes in the app. Just pick one you like and follow the steps for amazing flavour. For me build quality and feel of the product is also important and Traeger nails both.
